scenarios.contract: Synced account passwords use Google-only protection (no sync passphrase): an explicit device-local toggle, off by default, whose UI says anyone with access to the Google account's Drive app data could read them. Passwords live only in platform secure storage and the replaceable credential-key/credential-vault app-data files from the handover's credential section, never in causal history, SQLite, logs or exports. Use shared/profile-core's vault codec or match shared/credential-vault-fixtures.json exactly (envelope, authenticated data, endpoint digest, merge and canonical key rules). Stage a received incoming/SMTP pair, test it against the account's own servers, activate it atomically and keep the previous pair on failure; never offer a password to another endpoint.
